demo.cliff: a toolkit gives a DM to a check it does not choose
teaches: `subType: "toolkit"` is the fifth equipment sub-type, and the one a referee reaches for after `equipment` itself.

A toolkit stores no check. Working without the right kit costs DM-2, a kit more than two TLs below the job can cost as much, and one more than two above it may give DM+2 (CSC p.125). Type it in the roll prompt's Custom DM.
`roll` is declared on every physical Item, but the equipment sheet draws no roll block, so a toolkit leaves it blank.
demo.trap: A toolkit is not an augment: it carries no `augment` block that does anything, and nothing on it is applied for you. Its DM depends on the job in hand, which no field on the Item can know.

system.description: A hard case of spanners, a meter and a spool of sealing tape. Enough to keep a launch running.
